subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should Workspaces expose `state:persist` plus the widget-state bridge and gateway methods as a supported durable custom-widget contract now?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation, but they cannot decide whether OpenClaw should permanently support this new extension API or accept the associated sandbox write boundary and compatibility obligations.

options.title: Approve the contract after proof
options.body: Confirm the public API direction, then require current-head browser proof, the corrected closing reference, and a rebased security review before merge.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Remove or narrow public documentation and treat the capability as internal until a stable contract and upgrade policy are defined.

options.title: Defer widget persistence
options.body: Pause this PR and its dependent notes work until maintainers choose a different state ownership or security model.

recommendation.title: Approve the contract after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the public API direction, then require current-head browser proof, the corrected closing reference, and a rebased security review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged integration established the current Workspaces owner boundary, persistence design, and custom-widget security model that this decision extends.
